Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is Refrens?

Refrens is a cloud-based, AI-powered, ISO certified platform that helps you manage your Invoicing, Accounting, Compliance, Payments, Expenses, Inventory, Sales, Clients, Vendors, and other business processes in one place.

Will my data be safe with Refrens?

As an ISO certified organization, we take utmost care when it comes to the security and privacy of your data. Read more about our privacy policy: https://www.refrens.com/privacy-policy

How reliable is your system? What is your uptime?

Refrens promises an uptime of 99% - which is among the best in the industry. Our robust system ensures that you are able to ensure your business operations without any interruptions.

Can the software adapt & scale as my business grows ?

Yes. Refrens is built to scale with your business, supporting more users, larger data volumes, and more complex workflows as your needs grow. Since it is cloud-based and continuously updated, you can expand without changing systems.
